neighbours.label: the letter piece 'ew' as its own subword (dew, Ew, Andrew, Madewell)
fire: Early in the day, fresh dew sparkled on the spider webs.
My cousin Andrew moved to Glasgow last year.
She wrinkled her nose and said, "Ewww, it smells awful."
The singer Adewale performed two encores at the festival.
He bought a denim jacket from Madewell for the trip.
The tent was soaked with dew by the time we woke up.
Our new coach is a quiet man named Matthew Hewson.
The kids shrieked "ew!" when the worm wriggled out.
quiet: Early in the day, fresh frost sparkled on the spider webs.
My cousin Daniel moved to Glasgow last year.
She wrinkled her nose and said, "Yuck, it smells awful."
The singer Olumide performed two encores at the festival.
He bought a denim jacket from Levi's for the trip.
The tent was soaked with rain by the time we woke up.
Our new coach is a quiet man named Thomas Carter.
The kids shrieked loudly when the worm wriggled out.

notes: Card top peaks 'ew' x12 (Badewanne, Madewell, Adewunmi, ewww) plus ' Andrew', ' dew'. Probe: ' dew' 0.63, 'Ew' 0.60, 'Andrew' 0.31, whole-word ' new'/' knew' under 0.1. Broad, small max (1.52).
